source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to amines and their classes (PDF 118-120).

blocks.text: Organic nitrogen compounds zindagi aur jadeed duniya ke liye zaroori hain. Amino acids aur nucleotides, jo proteins aur nucleic acids ki bunyad hain, mein nitrogen hai. Amines aur nitro compounds rang ki sanat aur dawaiyon mein ahem hain; nylon, Kevlar aur polyurethane nitrogen wale polymers hain; aur nitrogen compounds khurak, khaad aur dhamaka khez maaddon mein bhi hain.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat: caffeine aur theobromine
blocks.text: Coffee ka caffeine aur chocolate ka theobromine dono organic nitrogen compounds hain jo hamein chust karte hain. In ki banawat mein aik methyl group ka farq hai: caffeine mein ring ke aik nitrogen par CH3 group hai jahan theobromine mein hydrogen atom hai.

blocks.alt: Do khuli banawatein saath saath, har aik mein chhe-kona ring paanch-kona ring se juri, C aur N atoms ke labels, do C=O groups aur N-CH3 groups. Caffeine mein teen ring nitrogens par CH3 hai; theobromine mein baen wale nitrogen par CH3 ki jagah H hai.
blocks.caption: Caffeine aur theobromine (kitab ke PDF safha 119 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono molecules ka dhaancha (skeleton) aik jaisa hai: chhe-kona aur paanch-kona ring aapas mein juri hui. Farq sirf baen taraf wale nitrogen par hai: caffeine mein wahan CH3 hai aur theobromine mein H. Kitab ne paanch-kona ring ke neeche wale carbon par H nahi dikhaya; carbon ke chaar bond poore karne ke liye drawing mein wahan C-H bana diya gaya hai.

Amines ammonia ke organic derivatives hain jin mein NH3 ke aik, do ya teen hydrogen atoms alkyl ya aryl groups se badle hon. Badle gaye hydrogen atoms ki tadaad un ki taqseem ki bunyad hai. IUPAC naamon mein amines ko alkanamines kehte hain.

items: Primary amines: -NH2 group par aik alkyl ya aryl group, maslan methanamine CH3NH2, ethanamine CH3CH2NH2, propan-1-amine CH3CH2CH2NH2 aur phenylamine (aniline) C6H5NH2.

blocks.alt: Primary amines: CH3-NH2 (methanamine), CH3-CH2-NH2 (ethanamine), CH3-CH2-CH2-NH2 (propan-1-amine), aur NH2 wali benzene ring (phenyl amine, aniline).
blocks.caption: Primary amines: methanamine, ethanamine, propan-1-amine aur phenyl amine (aniline) (kitab ke PDF safha 119 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Secondary amines: -NH- group par do groups, maslan N-methylmethanamine CH3NHCH3, N-methylethanamine CH3NHCH2CH3 aur diphenylamine (C6H5)2NH.

blocks.alt: Secondary amines: CH3-NH-CH3 (N-methylmethanamine), CH3-NH-CH2-CH3 (N-methylethanamine), aur NH se juri do benzene rings (diphenyl amine).
blocks.caption: Secondary amines: N-methylmethanamine, N-methylethanamine aur diphenyl amine (kitab ke PDF safha 119 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ne N-methylmethanamine ko CH3-NH2-CH3 aur N-methylethanamine ko CH3-NH2-CH2-CH3 chhapa hai. Yeh ghalat hai: do groups se jure nitrogen par sirf aik H hota hai (-NH-), warna nitrogen ke chaar bond ho jate aur woh neutral na rehta. Is liye drawing mein CH3-NH-CH3 aur CH3-NH-CH2-CH3 likha hai, jaisa list mein bhi hai.

items: Tertiary amines: aik hi nitrogen atom par teen groups, maslan N,N-dimethylmethanamine (CH3)3N aur triphenylamine (C6H5)3N.

blocks.alt: Tertiary amines: N,N-dimethylmethanamine jis ke N par teen CH3 groups hain (aik oopar, do dono taraf), aur triphenylamine, jis ka N teen benzene rings se jura hai.
blocks.caption: Tertiary amines: N,N-dimethylmethanamine aur triphenylamine (kitab ke PDF safha 119 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Quaternary ammonium salts: chaar groups wala nitrogen, maslan tetramethylammonium chloride [(CH3)4N]+ Cl-.

blocks.alt: Tetramethylammonium chloride: chaar CH3 groups wala nitrogen atom (oopar, neeche, baen, daen) square brackets mein, bracket ke bahar + charge, aur saath Cl-.
blocks.caption: Tetramethylammonium chloride, aik quaternary ammonium namak (kitab ke PDF safha 120 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Nitrogen par shaakh
blocks.text: Amine primary, secondary ya tertiary hai, yeh nitrogen atom par shaakhon se tay hota hai, us se jure carbon se nahi. Yeh alcohols ya halogenoalkanes jaisa nahi.

blocks.explanation: (i) 4-methylpentan-1-amine; (ii) butan-2-amine (kitab khud likhti hai ke NH2 muraad tha); (iii) N,4-diethylhexan-3-amine (C-N carbon se guzarti sab se lambi zanjeer chhe carbon ki hai).

blocks.prompt: 2,4-dimethylhexan-3-amine, N-methylpentan-1-amine, 2-methylcyclohexan-1-amine aur N,N-dimethylethanamine ke structures likhein.
blocks.explanation: CH3CH(CH3)CH(NH2)CH(CH3)CH2CH3; CH3CH2CH2CH2CH2NHCH3; cyclohexane ring jis ke C1 par NH2 aur agle carbon par CH3; CH3CH2N(CH3)2.

items: Amines: ammonia jis ke H alkyl ya aryl groups se badle.
Primary RNH2, secondary R2NH, tertiary R3N, quaternary R4N+ namak.
Qism nitrogen par groups se tay.
